character: LAVA KNIGHT armor: heavy overlapping plates of black obsidian and dark basalt with a rough cooled-lava surface; glowing orange-yellow molten cracks and veins running through every plate; edges trimmed with dark bronze. Short jagged flame-shaped spikes of cooled magma on both shoulder pauldrons, the outer forearms and the outer calves. Closed helmet with two swept-back curved obsidian horns and a narrow glowing ember visor slit. A molten core gem glowing in the middle of the chest. Segmented armored leg plates, clawed armored gauntlets, heavy armored boots with spiked toe caps. Palette: black, charcoal, dark bronze, glowing orange with yellow-hot cracks. No blue, no feathers, no fire or smoke around the body: the glow stays inside the cracks.
